Seal in hydration and repair your skin overnight with PRANA’s Ashwagandha Day Moisturizer. Infused with adaptogenic ashwagandha, licorice extract, almond oil, and gotu kola, this fragrance-free cream soothes irritation, boosts firmness, and protects against environmental stressors. Its lightweight, non-greasy texture leaves skin soft, supple, and radiant by morning, ideal for mature or sensitive skin.

  • How to Use: After applying the Bakuchiol Serum, scoop a coin-sized amount into your palm. Massage gently onto your face and neck in upward strokes. Use nightly to lock in moisture and enhance skin resilience.
  • Benefits: Deeply hydrates, reduces redness, promotes collagen for firmness, and restores a youthful glow with Ayurvedic ingredients.
settings.ggQpuBoDg8k_text:
Next, indulge in PRANA’s Bakuchiol Anti-Aging Serum, a plant-based retinol alternative derived from the Babchi plant (Psoralea corylifolia). Blended with squalane and jojoba oil, this lightweight serum reduces fine lines, evens skin tone, and boosts collagen without irritation or sun sensitivity, making it ideal for sensitive skin. In just 4 weeks, 106 women aged 28-35 reported smoother texture and brighter complexion.

  • How to Use: After cleansing, take 2-3 drops into your palm. Gently massage into your face and neck using upward strokes. Apply nightly for best results, allowing your skin to repair while you sleep.
  • Benefits: Smooths fine lines, minimizes pores, brightens hyperpigmentation, and firms skin with a gentle, vegan formula. Perfect for anti-aging without harsh retinoids.
settings.ggSrtJpO9ha_text:
Begin your nighttime ritual by gently cleansing away the day’s impurities with PRANA’s Rose & Jasmine Face Cleanser. Infused with soothing rose and jasmine, this toxin-free cleanser refreshes your skin while maintaining its natural moisture balance. Its gentle formula calms irritation and preps your skin for optimal absorption, ensuring a clean canvas for the next steps.

  • How to Use: Wet your face and neck. Dispense 2-3 pumps into your palm, gently massage in circular motions focusing on the T-zone, and rinse with warm water. Pat dry. Use daily for a refreshed, hydrated glow.
  • Benefits: Removes dirt and oil without stripping, soothes sensitive skin, and promotes a radiant complexion with Ayurvedic botanicals.
